findings.message: Next.js configuration file not loaded as expected
findings.explanation: This Next.js version does not load a configuration file with this name: it ignores next.config.ts before Next.js 15 and fails on the other names.
findings.remediation: Use next.config.js, next.config.mjs, or, from Next.js 15, next.config.ts.

findings.message: Next.js version outside the validated range
findings.explanation: Frameshift V1 validates Next.js 14 to 16. This version is analyzed, and version-dependent rules behave conservatively.
findings.remediation: Upgrade to a validated Next.js version, or review the results with extra care.

findings.explanation: No lockfile was read, so the Next.js version is the lowest version of the declared range, or unknown. If this package is a member of a workspace, run Frameshift on the workspace root and select the package.
findings.remediation: Install the dependencies so that the lockfile resolves next, then run Frameshift again.
